0022600027.text: The 76ers (8-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) visit the Cavaliers (4-3, 5th in the East, 2nd in the Central) for their 10th game of the season, bringing a five-game winning streak and a 4-0 road record into Cleveland. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Adem Bona (day-to-day, head, game-time decision), while Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (out, hamstring soreness). The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 114-106 win in Philadelphia on 2026-10-22, and they lost all four meetings with the Cavaliers in 2025-26.
